name: Mirage Sword
desc: A sword that floats in the air. It is capable of cloning itself to attack enemies in accordance with its wielder's movements.

eff.name: Phantom Reflection
eff.desc1: Deals ice damage. Increases critical damage when used behind the target.
eff.desc2: Deals ice damage. Damage is increased when used in front of the target.

eff.name: Chain Boost
eff.desc1: Increases critical damage by [Lv. x 5]% when the action that granted this effect is used in succession.
eff.desc2: Increases damage by [Lv. x 3]% when the action that granted this effect is used in succession.

eff.name: Item Uses Up
eff.desc1: Increases item use count by Lv.
